notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
The time has come.
Darkness stirs, and ancient powers awaken. In this exclusive demo, step into a world at the edge of ruin — where every shadow hides a secret, and every path leads to fate.

Wield your chosen skills, test your resolve in battle, and uncover fragments of a forgotten tale.
This is only the beginning... and your legend starts now.


Add to your wishlist and follow for updates — be the first to open the gates and begin the battle against the darkness.
